Do not substitute idle poses and do not redraw an action.

Repair only the missing canonical equipment. The paladin has exactly ONE compact gold warhammer with rectangular red-inset head, at the character's anatomical RIGHT hip (PICTURE LEFT in front view), and exactly ONE small red/gold cross holy book at anatomical LEFT hip (PICTURE RIGHT in front view). Keep the book already present; do not duplicate it or replace action props with it. Match the master hammer shape, size and proportions: short handle, broad compact rectangular head, total length roughly one fifth of character height. Never move the hammer to the other hip between paired action cells.
All original action props remain distinct from equipped hammer/book: no converting cards, fans, toys, food or paperwork into extra holy equipment. Exactly two anatomical arms and hands, except legal occlusion.
Keep genuine transparent background; no labels, borders, checkerboard, extra decoration, duplicate body parts, or new effects. Preserve every original cell's different action.

Props and both hands remain exactly as target. Cloth or hotpot may partly occlude the hammer but no weapon side swapping.
